LambdaTest — automated testing

lambdatest/automate · version 1

envs add lambdatest/automate

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
LT_USERNAME required secret LambdaTest states nothing about either half, unlike both of its competitors, so both are secret here. Its dashboard is now branded TestMu AI, which is where the credentials page moved to.. where to get it
LT_ACCESS_KEY required secret The other half. LambdaTest documents no rotation, only where to read the current values.. where to get it
